correctness.rationale: The argument separates exact finite conditioned edge counts from the limiting estimate. Uniform marked-set probabilities of orders 2,3,4 follow from degree-bound one-step comparisons and telescoping complete-graph survival. Conditional extra forbidden edges have expectations O(k^2/N) and O(k/N), making the pair-survival relative error O(log N/N), including the bounded final stage. Triangle-freeness ensures all final states have 0 or 2 vacancies; disjoint forbidden-pair events sum without overcount. The companion exact-rational checker passed 62 assertions; finite enumeration is supplemental, not a proof of the limit.

value.rationale: A global all-size first-order asymptotic for random irreversible matching on nearly complete graphs resolves a natural nontrivial jamming event with probability O(1/N); topology-independent coefficient 3|E(H)|/N^2 and the excluded-cycle law differ from naively uniform leftover-pair probability by a factor 3/2. Control of overlapping forbidden edges requires a structural marked-set argument, not a finite census.
